build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: __now when available; otherwise Date.now. Calibration >=50ms, median of seven samples.
order: Three complete 33-case invocations per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 297 values checked. All FormatJS before/after values match. Only comparator differences: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Captured Array.isArray skips Locale brand probe for arrays. Full list traversal, coercion, canonicalization and duplicate removal retained.

conformance.hermes: All 12 Test262 suites pass existing gates, including strict getCanonicalLocales. Realm exclusions unchanged. Native canonicalizer/Locale/ListFormat tests pass.
conformance.oracles: Pinned ICU4C/J locale-formatting and ICU4X ListFormat gates pass.
conformance.observableBehavior: Sparse proxy HasProperty/Get ordering, invalid trailing locale, revoked proxy, captured Array.isArray, nested array coercion and Array newTarget Locale branding.

limits: Other API constructor and steady-state gaps remain. No claim of full goal completion.

commands.benchmark: bazel build -c opt //benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension:overlap_bytecode; run cquery artifact on each pinned optimized host
